sourceVersion: AUHSD 2025-2026 Student/Teacher Calendar, Board Approved December 19, 2024
heroSummary: Anaheim Union High School District schedules 180 student days and 185 teacher days from August 6 through May 21. High-school-only minimum days fall at the end of each semester, and May 26 through June 1 are reserved as potential make-up days.
seoTitle: AUHSD Calendar 2025-2026 | Holidays, Minimum Days & PDF
seoDescription: AUHSD Calendar 2025-2026 with first day, last student day, holidays, non-student days, staff development days, quarter dates, minimum days, PDF and ICS download.
calendarNotes: Anaheim Union High School District starts the 2025-2026 school year on August 6, 2025 and lists May 21, 2026 as the last scheduled student day. The Student/Teacher Calendar lists 180 student days, 185 teacher days, four quarters, staff development days with no students, teacher days with no students, high-school-only minimum days, quarter and semester minimum days, holidays, and potential make-up days from May 26-June 1.

calendarFaqs.q: When does AUHSD start school in 2025?
calendarFaqs.a: Anaheim Union High School District starts school on Wednesday, August 6, 2025.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last scheduled student day for AUHSD in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: The last scheduled student day is Thursday, May 21, 2026. The official PDF also underlines May 26-June 1 as days subject to change to regular school days if needed to meet the state minimum.

calendarFaqs.q: Does AUHSD have a traditional spring break in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: The AUHSD calendar does not label a traditional spring break. It marks March 23-26, 2026 as non-student/non-teacher days and March 27, 2026 as a holiday.

calendarFaqs.q: When is AUHSD Thanksgiving Break in 2025?
calendarFaqs.a: The calendar marks November 24-26, 2025 as non-student/non-teacher days and November 27-28, 2025 as holidays.

calendarFaqs.q: How many student days are in the AUHSD 2025-2026 calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: The official AUHSD 2025-2026 Student/Teacher Calendar lists 180 student days and 185 teacher days.

calendarFaqs.q: How do I add the AUHSD calendar to Google Calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: Download the AUHSD ICS calendar file from this page, open Google Calendar, choose Import, upload the ICS file, and confirm the imported dates. The file is a one-time calendar import, not a live district sync.

customSections.label: AUHSD Calendar Overview 2025-2026
customSections.content: The AUHSD 2025-2026 Student/Teacher Calendar provides districtwide dates for grades 7-12. Families can use it to track the first day of school, last scheduled student day, quarters, semester dates, holidays, non-student/non-teacher days, teacher days, staff development days, high-school-only minimum days, and potential make-up days.

customSections.label: Important AUHSD Dates Parents Should Know
customSections.content: These AUHSD dates are common planning anchors for transportation, childcare, progress monitoring, appointments, and end-of-year planning.

customSections.label: Changes From Next Year's AUHSD Calendar
customSections.content: Families comparing AUHSD school years can use this summary to see how major planning dates shift before arranging transportation, childcare, travel, testing, and summer activities.

customSections.label: How We Verify AUHSD Calendar Dates
customSections.content:
MySchoolDates reviews the official AUHSD calendars page and Student/Teacher Calendar PDF, compares key dates such as first day, last scheduled student day, quarter dates, semester dates, holidays, non-student/non-teacher days, teacher days, staff development days, high-school-only minimum days, progress report dates, grade due dates, and potential make-up days, then converts the reviewed records into the calendar file used on this page.

The official AUHSD calendar remains the source of record for revisions, campus-specific events, emergency closures, bell schedules, and same-day announcements.
